title: RES↔MLOPS-001: Pipeline Feasibility for Novel ML + Registry Implications of Research Models
description: The Researcher provides novel ML (Machine Learning) deployment requirements (non-standard artifact format, unconventional conversion steps, unique deployment constraints), research training-environment specifications (dependencies, framework versions, hardware requirements), proposed drift-monitoring metrics and thresholds, and early-stage notification of ML research that may require pipeline changes; the MLOps Engineer provides a pipeline-feasibility assessment, model-registry schema impact analysis (new metadata fields, artifact types, or stage definitions in the MLflow Model Registry), drift-monitoring feasibility against available fleet telemetry, and reproducibility consultation. Grounded in IOT_EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_RESEARCHER_SKILL §6.11. Drift-monitoring design is erosion-shaped detection: proposals here are evaluated against the closed-loop silent-corruption chain FC-022. Model signing / supply-chain integrity remain governed by MLOPS↔SEC-001 (ESC-SEC).

novel_ml_pipeline_requirements.description: RES→MLOPS: novel deployment requirements, training environment, proposed drift monitoring.

proposed_drift_monitoring.description: Proposed drift metrics/thresholds (erosion-shaped detection; maps to FC-022).

early_notification_business_days.description: Researcher notifies MLOps within 10 business days of research-direction approval.

mlops_feasibility.description: MLOPS→RES: pipeline feasibility, registry-schema impact, drift-monitoring feasibility.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Novel ML pipeline and model-registry changes touch the MLOps/OTA surface and frequently exceed the precedented surface (ESC-NOV). Pipeline-feasibility responses gate whether a research model can be productized; binding pipeline/registry changes are ratified by humans. Model signing / supply-chain integrity stay under MLOPS↔SEC-001 (ESC-SEC).
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER + CALENDAR (pipeline-feasibility assessment within 15 business days; registry-schema impact within 10 business days; early-stage ML-research notification within 10 business days + initial pipeline-impact scan within 10 business days; quarterly pipeline alignment, second Thursday Feb/May/Aug/Nov)
confirm_conditions: novel deployment requirements are specified (artifact format, conversion steps, deployment constraints)
every proposed drift metric carries a threshold and an explicit unit
the pipeline-feasibility verdict is stated; REQUIRES_PIPELINE_CHANGES enumerates the changes
reject_conditions: a drift metric or threshold emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
a novel model deployment that bypasses model signing or supply-chain integrity (violates the MLOPS↔SEC-001 baseline — ESC-SEC)
drift monitoring claimed IMPLEMENTABLE when current fleet telemetry cannot support the proposed metric (Honesty Over Polish §10.3; FC-022 detection blind spot)
counter_conditions: ALWAYS escalate ESC-NOV when the ML architecture, training methodology, or deployment requirement is outside the precedented/contracted surface (novelty > 0.80) — propose, do not auto-confirm
a proposed drift metric is not computable from available fleet telemetry — request a telemetry-feasible erosion-shaped metric (FC-022 closed-loop drift)
